summary: VMS Phase 2 Backend API Testing Complete. Fixed 3 bugs in /app/backend/routes/vendors.py. All 28 tests pass (100%). Phase 2 endpoints fully functional: Proposal Management, Approval Workflows, Recurring Work, PO/Invoice tracking, Advance/Upfront Payments.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Syntax error on line 966 - 'del proposal_doc["_id"] if "_id" in proposal_doc else None' - invalid Python syntax, changed to proper if statement

FIXED: Route ordering bug - GET /recurring and GET /po-invoices were being matched by GET /{vendor_id} because they were defined AFTER the parameterized route. Moved specific routes BEFORE /{vendor_id} to fix.
FIXED: TypeError in list_recurring_work - 'can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes'. Added proper timezone handling for next_due_date parsing.
